 About the job:﻿﻿ 
 We are looking for a QA Tester (AQA) with a strong foundation in manual testing to support and expand our automation efforts.  This role is not just about writing scripts. It requires a deep understanding of what to test, how to test, and why it matters. You will ensure product quality through a combination of solid QA practices and automation-first execution.  
 What You’ll get to do: 
 Quality Assurance and Test Design (Foundation) 
Understand business requirements and translate them into clear, structured test scenarios  
Design effective test coverage including positive, negative, edge cases, and risk-based scenarios  
Identify gaps, risks, and potential failure points early in the development cycle  
Perform root cause analysis and provide clear defect reports with impact assessment  
 Automation Development and Ownership 
Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts (UI and API), primarily using Playwright  
Ensure automation reflects real user behaviour and meaningful test scenarios  
Contribute to improving the automation framework for scalability and maintainability  
Continuously expand automation coverage to reduce manual regression effort  
 Test Execution (Manual and Automated) 
Execute both manual and automated tests depending on context and coverage needs  
Perform exploratory and ad-hoc testing for new or complex features  
Validate automation results and ensure reliability of test outcomes 
Identify regression scope and ensure critical areas are properly covered  
 CI/CD and Quality Visibility 
Integrate and maintain automated tests within CI/CD pipelines  
Monitor test execution results and investigate failures  
Provide clear reporting on test results, risks, and quality status  
Support release decisions with data-driven insights  
 Collaboration 
Work closely with developers, product managers, and QA to align on quality expectations 
Participate in agile ceremonies such as stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives 
Share knowledge and contribute to improving QA and automation practices across the team  
 What we’re Looking For:
 QA and Testing Fundamentals
Strong foundation in manual testing and QA methodologies 
Ability to understand requirements and design effective test scenarios 
Experience in defect analysis and risk-based testing 
 Automation and Technical Skills 
Hands-on experience with test automation tools (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium)  
Basic programming knowledge (preferably JavaScript) 
Experience with API testing Familiarity with Git or version control  
 Soft Skills 
Strong problem-solving and attention to detail  
Good communication skills in English  
Proactive mindset and willingness to learn
